title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
“飘起来，落下去！”
“飘起来，落下去！”
这个游戏，盘古在梦中玩了一万八千年。
在这一万八千年里，天和地紧紧连在一起，
就像一个大鸡蛋，飘浮在茫茫的宇宙中。而盘
古就在里面孕育、长大、沉睡。
page_text_en:
"Float up, fall down!"
"Float up, fall down!"
This game, Pangu played in his dream for 18,000 years.
During these 18,000 years, heaven and earth were tightly connected,
like a giant egg, floating in the vast universe. And Pangu
was growing and sleeping inside it.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了盘古在混沌中沉睡的场景，文字说明他通过‘飘起来，落下去’的游戏在梦中度过了万八千年，天地如大鸡蛋般相连，盘古在其中孕育、长大、沉睡。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
有一天，盘古睁开了眼睛，可四周黑漆漆的，什么也看不见。他竖起耳朵听了听，一点儿声音也没有。
盘古动动身子，想伸一个长长的懒腰。可是，就像被厚厚的被子包裹着，他的手脚都伸展不开。
page_text_en:
One day, Pangu opened his eyes, but everything around him was pitch black, and he could see nothing. He perked up his ears to listen, but there was not a single sound.
Pangu moved his body, wanting to stretch out a long yawn. But it was as if he were wrapped in thick blankets, and his hands and feet couldn't stretch out at all.
summary_zh: 盘古在混沌中醒来，发现四周漆黑一片，听不到任何声音，想伸懒腰却因被包裹而无法舒展身体。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
盘古在身边摸索着，碰到一柄斧子。他抡起斧子，朝四周挥舞，只听“咔嚓”一声，包裹他的东西裂开一条缝，一丝亮光透了进来。
真亮呀！
盘古更有劲儿了，他不停地挥动斧子，终于将包裹他的东西砸成了碎片。
包裹物中像蛋清一样轻而清的东西飘了起来，慢慢上升，变成了天；像蛋黄一样重而浊的东西渐渐下沉，变成了地。
page_text_en:
Pangu was searching around and touched an axe. He swung the axe around, and with a 'crack,' the thing wrapping him split open a crack, and a ray of light came in.
How bright it is!
Pangu became even more energetic. He kept swinging the axe and finally smashed the thing wrapping him into pieces.
The light and clear substance in the wrapping, like egg white, floated up and slowly rose to become the sky; the heavy and turbid substance, like egg yolk, gradually sank down to become the earth.
summary_zh: 盘古在混沌中醒来后，用斧子劈开包裹他的混沌，使轻清之物上升为天，重浊之物下沉为地，天地由此分开。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
盘古站了起来，他伸伸手就能摸到天，跺跺脚，大地就嗡嗡震动。
他高兴地大叫：“啊——”
“啊——啊——啊——”天地之间只听到阵阵回响。
盘古向四周打量，到处光秃秃的，什么都没有。他不停地向前跑，想找个伙伴儿，可是一个人也没有遇到。
page_text_en:
Pangu stood up. He could touch the sky by stretching his hands, and the earth trembled with every step he took.
He happily shouted: "Ah——"
"Ah——ah——ah——" Only echoes rang out between heaven and earth.
Pangu looked around. Everywhere was bare and empty. He kept running forward, hoping to find a companion, but he met no one.
summary_zh: 盘古站起身来，发现天地初开，四周空旷无人，他兴奋地呼喊却只听到回声，于是开始四处奔跑寻找伙伴。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
“砰！”有什么东西碰到了盘古的头。他抬眼一看，发现刚刚还在自己头上一尺的天，现在已经碰到他的头顶了。
唉呀，是不是天地又要合拢了？如果天地合拢，周围是不是又会一片漆黑？那可不行！
盘古赶紧站稳，双手托住天，往上举。
page_text_en:
"Bang!" Something hit Pangu's head. He looked up and saw that the sky, which had just been one chi above his head, had now touched the top of his head.
Oh no, is the sky and earth about to close again? If they close, won't everything become dark again? That can't be allowed!
Pangu quickly steadied himself, held up the sky with both hands, and pushed it upward.
summary_zh: 盘古发现天地有合拢的迹象，担心再次陷入黑暗，于是用双手托住天空向上顶，以阻止天地重新闭合。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
举着天，什么也不能做，盘古就跳着玩儿。
左脚跳，右脚跳，双脚跳。
page_text_en:
Holding up the sky, with nothing else to do, Pangu jumped around for fun.
Left foot jump, right foot jump, both feet jump.
summary_zh: 盘古为了防止天地重新合拢，用双手托住天空，因无法做其他事，便开心地跳着玩儿。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
他还会两只手换着举天。
单手举，双手举，把天从左手抛
到右手，再从右手抛到左手。
page_text_en:
He would also take turns holding up the sky with each hand.
One hand, then two hands, tossing the sky from his left hand
to his right, then back from his right to his left.
summary_zh: 盘古为了防止天地合拢，用双手托举天空，并换着双手交替举天，玩耍般地抛接天空。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
当盘古把所有能想到的游戏都玩遍后，他垂下头，“呼噜呼噜”打起了瞌睡。
打瞌睡时，盘古呼出的气变成一团团的白云，飘浮在他胸前背后。
page_text_en:
After Pangu had played all the games he could think of, he lowered his head and began to snore, 'H噜 H噜'.
As he dozed, the breath he exhaled turned into fluffy white clouds, floating before and behind him.
summary_zh: 盘古在托举天地后玩累了，垂下头打起瞌睡，他呼出的气化作白云飘浮在身前身后。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
不知不觉，又是一万八千年过去了，天被盘古举着，每天升高一丈，已经有九万里高，盘古也随着越长越高；地也每天增厚一丈，已经有九万里厚。
盘古放下了手，天和地已经固定，不会再合拢了。
盘古长成了天地间唯一的巨人。
page_text_en:
Unknowingly, another 18,000 years had passed. The sky, held up by Pangu, rose one zhang each day and had already reached 90,000 li high; Pangu grew taller with it. The earth thickened one zhang each day and had also become 90,000 li thick.
Pangu let go of his hands. The sky and earth were now fixed and would never close together again.
Pangu had grown into the only giant between heaven and earth.
summary_zh: 盘古托举天地一万八千年，天高九万里，地厚九万里，天地稳固不再合拢，盘古长成天地间唯一的巨人。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
他跨一步，可以到达天边；
他踢一脚，可以踏平大地；
他吹一口气，能让天空抖三抖；
他怒吼一声，天空就阴沉沉的，乌云翻滚。
不管散步还是奔跑，高兴还是伤心，天地间都
只有他一个人，盘古很孤单，也太累了。
summary_zh: 盘古在托举天地后，因天地间只有他一人而感到孤单和疲惫，他的一举一动都能影响天地，但无人陪伴让他心生倦意。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh: 他躺下来，睡着了，呼呼的鼾声变成滚滚雷鸣，响彻天地。
page_text_en: He lay down and fell asleep. His snoring turned into rolling thunder, echoing throughout heaven and earth.
summary_zh: 盘古躺下睡着了，他呼出的气化作云，鼾声化作雷鸣响彻天地。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
盘古这一睡，就再也没有醒来，他的身体渐渐和天地融为一体。
他的眼睛升上天空，左眼变成了太阳，带来温暖和光明；右眼变成了月亮，洒下皎洁的光辉。头发和胡须化成了闪闪的星星，点亮美丽的夜空。
page_text_en:
Pangu fell asleep and never woke up again. His body gradually merged with heaven and earth.
His eyes rose into the sky: his left eye became the sun, bringing warmth and light; his right eye became the moon, casting pure, gentle radiance. His hair and beard turned into sparkling stars, lighting up the beautiful night sky.
summary_zh: 盘古在托举天地后沉睡，身体化为日月星辰，与天地融为一体，创造了自然界的光明与美丽。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh: 盘古的胳膊、腿和身躯，变成了巍峨的高山，肌肉变成肥沃的土地，汗毛化作土地上葳蕤的花草树木，汗珠就成了滋润大地的雨水和甘露。大地披上了绿毯，鸟语花香。
page_text_en: Pangu's arms, legs, and body turned into majestic mountains; his muscles became fertile soil; his sweat hairs became lush flowers, grass, and trees on the land; and his sweat droplets became the rain and dew that nourish the earth. The land was covered with a green carpet, and birds sang among fragrant blossoms.
summary_zh: 盘古沉睡后，身体化为山川、土地、花草树木和雨露，大地变得生机盎然，鸟语花香。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
盘古的筋脉变成了或笔直或弯曲的道路，
血液成为江河，奔流不息。
他的牙齿、骨头、骨髓则变成了闪光的金属、
坚硬的石头、圆润的珍珠和流光溢彩的玉石。
page_text_en:
Pangu's tendons became straight or winding roads,
His blood became rivers, flowing ceaselessly.
His teeth, bones, and marrow turned into shining metals,
Hard stones, round pearls, and lustrous jade.
summary_zh: 盘古的身体继续化为自然万物，他的筋脉成为道路，血液化作江河，牙齿、骨头和骨髓则变成了金属、石头、珍珠和玉石，大地因此更加丰富多样。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
page_text_ocr_zh:
盘古身上的虫子，被风吹过，变成了人。
人们在土地上忙忙碌碌，让盘古开辟出的新天地更加生机勃勃。
page_text_en:
The insects on Pangu's body, blown by the wind, turned into people.
People busily worked on the land, making the new world opened by Pangu even more vibrant and full of life.
summary_zh: 盘古身上的虫子化作人类，人们在大地上劳作生活，使新天地充满生机。

title_en: Pangu Opens the Sky and Earth
summary_zh: 画面中，盘古仰面躺卧在云朵之上，双臂高举托举天空，神情疲惫而安详，周围云雾缭绕，象征其托举天地后沉睡的场景。
